NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · The Next Frontier

Earth Analogs for the Moon and Mars

Where on Earth can we rehearse for the lunar South Pole and the Martian surface? We compare real places on our planet with their counterparts on the Moon and Mars, and we show the differences as clearly as the similarities.

Challenge: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars
Team: [EARTHBEARS] · [Eskisehir Local Event]

If a page stays blank, open it directly: Moon comparison · Mars explorer

What we compare

  • Landform and relief
  • Rock type and how the terrain formed
  • Temperature, ice and light conditions
  • What Earth cannot imitate: gravity, vacuum, permanent shadow

Data and sources

  • Lunar unit names follow Spudis et al. (2008) and Wilhelms et al. (1979)
  • Earth site imagery in the Moon page: Google Earth
  • 3D relief in the Moon page is an estimate, not measured elevation data
  • Mars and Earth base maps: https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/maps-of-mars-global-topography/
  • https://earth.google.com/web/
  • https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/cms/asset/0302eb54-3e52-49f1-90a9-ba4478874915/grl24773-fig-0003.png

Limits and AI use

  • Similarity ratings are our own judgment, not published equivalences
  • AI tools used: We used Claude AI to review our codes.
Built for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. This is a student project and is not a NASA product.
